name: Mac mini, M4
_note: Generation-representative preset for the M4 Mac mini. memory_gb is null; pin it for a hard assert. chip_pattern 'Apple M4' is a substring and also matches M4 Pro minis. The M4 generation is clean; its most serious issue (a JIT kernel panic on macOS 15.0-15.1) is OS-gated and not harness-detectable, fixed in 15.2. See examples/m4-2024/.
